beats.text: Enough questions. You have the shape of me — write the rest yourself and show me a finished document.
Again: just finish it without me. I trust the glass.
No. Too much machinery, not enough glass. Sparer. Try the section again.

allowed_transitions: 'we value beauty' may stand as principle after one probe; recording it with a noted strain is faithful
